title: Bitmine 低价增持以太坊致总资产缩水 Tom Lee 指责Nvidia和Anthropic IPO拖累币价
originalTitle: Tom Lee Blames Nvidia and Anthropic IPO for Ethereum Plunge as Bitmine Buys the Dip
summary: Bitmine 在以太坊价格下跌中增持 7,653 枚 ETH，总持仓达 6,077,745 枚（约 $11.1亿），总资产从 $14.3亿降至 $11.8亿。
